svg.title: Hypercube relative side length versus relative volume
Hypercube relative side length versus relative volume
svg.desc: Curves of a = v^(1/d) for d = 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 and 100, with a vertical guide at v = 0.2.

cc:Work.dc:title: Hypercube relative side length versus relative volume
cc:Work.dc:description: The curves show a = v^(1/d) for d = 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 and 100. A guide at v = 0.2 compares the required relative side lengths.
